findings.origin_note: Root self-check raised the index concern; independent reviewer inspected exact ledger and canonical selection before classifying.
findings.scope: Report source-ledger index only; canonical scientific selection is correct.
findings.problem: source-ledger.primary_scopes[polypeptone].bindings enumerates original decisions/proposals/evidence.json but omits the selected -v2 files, without explicitly classifying those indexed originals as historical. Tellurium index similarly includes authoring-v1 alongside selected root files. Because these sit under reviewed primary scopes, the index alone cannot identify exact final selected fragments and could point a reader to pre-remediation evidence.

correct_canonical_selection.locator: fragment_bindings selects correct Polypeptone decisions-v2/proposals-v2/evidence-v2 and current tellurium root files

findings.bounded_remedy: Preserve native-bound source-ledger and all histories. Append explicit selected-origin-bindings.json identifying canonical final six fragment paths/hashes, primary author/manifest and selected payload bindings; state the older source-ledger bindings are a historical index, not the selection rule. Include this clarification in the final handoff/manifest or supplemental finding receipt. No canonical D/P/E, native review or payload edit required.
